name: Hair, Skin & Nails Gummies
short_description: Daily beauty gummies that nourish your hair, skin and nails — in a passion fruit gummy you will actually look forward to.
long_description: Glow Hair, Skin & Nails is a daily beauty supplement in a passion fruit gummy. Beauty routines usually work from the outside in; this one works the other way round, supporting hair, skin and nails as part of your everyday routine. Vegetarian friendly, non-GMO, gluten free and made in the USA.

serving.directions: Take one gummy daily. Chew thoroughly before swallowing. Do not exceed the recommended dose.
